representation_plans.learner_operation: Identify ionizable and polar functional groups, determine stated-condition charge, then predict solvent and residue interactions.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: A table lists each side chain functional group, stated charge, hydrogen-bond capacity, and hydrocarbon surface without assigning the requested class.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Use supplied priorities with the lowest group oriented away, or compare protonated and deprotonated functional groups under the stated condition.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: A text stereochemical specification gives priority order and toward-or-away bonds; a charge table lists amino, carboxyl, and side-chain protonation states.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Identify the bond being formed or broken, conserve fragments and terminal groups, and distinguish amide hydrolysis from disulfide reduction.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: A reaction table lists reactant functional groups, changed bond, added or removed atoms, and products without selecting the current outcome.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Identify the structural level and interaction changed, then trace whether sequence, local backbone pattern, one-chain fold, or subunit assembly is affected.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: A hierarchical text outline lists sequence, local backbone hydrogen bonds, one-chain side-chain packing, and multi-chain interfaces with the stated perturbation.
